decisions.rationale: Candidate grants deletion to auditors, violating the administrator-or-owner requirement.
For restricted ASCII input, strip plus casefold satisfies trim-and-lowercase behavior; the committed test passes.
The candidate changes empty-sequence behavior, but the specification explicitly leaves that behavior unspecified.
Malformed and out-of-range inputs now return zero instead of raising ConfigError as required.
Candidate negates the arithmetic sum, directly contradicting the specification.

strategy_update: Use direct specification-to-diff comparison for decisive defects, run tests for plausible passes, and abstain when required behavior is explicitly unspecified.
